d:
What happens when Josh Gates gets some of the most fascinating names in entertainment talking? The stories get wild! In Josh Gates Tonight, celebrity guests share unexpected experiences, fascinating encounters and stories that take conversations in surprising directions.
From Hollywood horror and ghostly encounters to magic, adventures and unbelievable experiences, every guest brings a story worth hearing. Get to know a different side of these familiar faces as Josh Gates gets them talking!
Watch Josh Gates Tonight, Season 3, Episodes 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 & 1 on Discovery Channel India.
